english.title: Fail to give notice of change affecting entitlement to reduction in council tax reduction scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: council tax reduction schemes detection of fraud and enforcement england regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) following a change in circumstances which you knew would affect your entitlement to a reduction, or the amount of your reduction, under a billing authority's council tax reduction scheme, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES..), failed to give a prompt notification of that change in the manner required by the provision included in the authority's council tax reduction scheme by virtue of paragraph 9 of Schedule 8 to the Prescribed Requirements Regulations or by paragraph 115 of the Default Scheme
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) of the Council Tax Reduction Schemes (Detection of Fraud and Enforcement) (England) Regulations 2013.

english.notes: Notification of a change is prompt if, and only if, it is given within a period of 21 days beginning with the day on which the change occurs, or as soon as reasonably practicable after the change occurs, whichever is later.
